faculty_group: In order to participate in this program, an employee must be in the United Faculty of Florida (UFF) bargaining unit or in the Faculty Pay Plan on a benefit eligible line, employed for a minimum of one (1) academic year for faculty members with instructional responsibilities or a minimum of one (1) calendar year for faculty members without instructional responsibilities, and employed on at least a 0.75 FTE line.
This program does not apply to individuals on a temporary, a term limited, or a visiting appointment.
All employees in the following position classifications holding regular, visiting, provisional, research, affiliate, or joint appointments are included in the bargaining unit:
eligible_parent: No more than twice during the career of a faculty member at the university, he or she shall be granted, upon request, a paid parental leave for the birth or adoption of a child.
entitlement: No more than twice during the career of a faculty member at the university, he or she shall be granted, upon request, a paid parental leave for the birth or adoption of a child.

No more than twice in the course of an employee’s tenure at the University, the employee may request and be granted a paid parental leave for the birth or adoption of a child not to exceed one semester (for instructional faculty) or three months for non-instructional employees.
Eligible faculty will be granted up to 19.5 contiguous weeks of paid leave or one semester (or up to three months for non-instructional faculty).
Program guidelines will be posted on the University’s website.

dual_employee_rule: In the circumstance that both parents are faculty members employed by the university, only one parent may request paid parental leave under this program for each qualifying event (birth or adoption).

time_window: The faculty member must request use of the paid parental leave in advance of the initiation of the parental leave, no later than three (3) months prior to the beginning of the leave, and the leave must occur no later than the academic semester immediately following the birth or adoption event.
notice: The faculty member must request use of the paid parental leave in advance of the initiation of the parental leave, no later than three (3) months prior to the beginning of the leave, and the leave must occur no later than the academic semester immediately following the birth or adoption event.

Do not reduce any leave balance below zero.
runs_concurrently_with: If FMLA eligibility requirements are satisfied, up to twelve (12) weeks of the paid parental leave will be designated as FMLA, and tracked concurrently.

notes: Sources: 2018_00_link.txt (HR Attendance and Leave Guide, Rev. 6/2017, includes the Faculty Paid Parental Leave program, guidelines and FAQs); 2018_01_uff_cba_2016_2019.txt (USF/UFF CBA 2016-2019, governing agreement for in-unit faculty); 2018_02_faculty_handbook_oct2017.txt (Faculty Handbook, October 2017; states it does not constitute terms of employment).

Governing document: the CBA (Art. 17.6 FMLA and the 6-month parental leave, 17.7 Parental Leave Paid Program, 17.8 sick leave, 17.11 leave without pay, 15.2(A) and 17.4 tenure). CBA 17.7(4) says program guidelines will be posted on the University's website; the HR guide's 'Faculty Paid Parental Leave' sections are read as those guidelines and supply the program's details. missing = false (the no-policy coding (`missing`) not triggered).
Reference date 2018-03-13. CBA in force (ratified 2016, to August 7, 2019); guide Rev. 6/2017 captured 2017-11-21; handbook revised October 2017.

Calendar: CBA Art. 30 defines 'semester' as 'one of the two approximately 19.5 week periods which together constitute the academic year'; the paid leave guidelines equate one semester with 19.5 contiguous weeks. That figure is an appointment period, not a term (first class to last exam), so it is not used as the term length: calendar.kind = semester, and the term length follows R8's order.

Chain, birth parent: USF Parental Leave (unpaid, up to 6 months from the birth, c2) containing the Paid Parental Leave (1 semester = 19.5 weeks from the start, c1 within c2), then accrued sick leave (c4) and, once balances are exhausted, Sick Leave Pool hours (6-8 weeks after delivery, c5) for the unpaid remainder; FMLA 12 workweeks alongside from the start (c3 concurrent_with c1 and c2).

Chain, non-birth parent: USF Parental Leave (up to 6 months, c2) containing the Paid Parental Leave (1 semester = 19.5 weeks, c1 within c2), then accrued sick leave (c4) for the remainder; FMLA 12 workweeks alongside from the start (c3). Only one parent per event may take the paid leave if both are USF faculty.

Timing of the paid leave: it must occur no later than the semester after the birth; a summer birth gives the paid leave in the following fall, and after a mid-semester birth the faculty member may use accrued or unpaid leave to finish the semester and take the next semester paid. Coded at the start of the parental leave (within c2), the longest-continuous reading; the deferred path would place 19.5 paid weeks after an unpaid/accrued stretch.

Paid leave payer: CBA 17.7(3) deducts the hours used from sick and/or annual balances at separation (a reimbursement commitment); the guide's separation procedure says not to reduce any balance below zero, and the paid period does not draw on balances. Coded payer employer under R1d (employer covers any shortfall); flagged for review.

Faculty in USF Health receiving clinical compensation are paid under 'USF Health procedures for Extended Leave' (not saved); the College of Medicine is outside the bargaining unit (CBA Appendix A). Main-campus arts and sciences and engineering faculty are in the unit.

Not components: compulsory disability leave (employer-imposed after a medical examination, CBA 17.8(C), guide) is not a leave a parent takes for a birth; job-related disability leave (workplace injury); administrative leave (death, jury, military, closings); sabbaticals and professional development leave (professional purposes); military leave; domestic violence leave. The handbook's list of benefits mentions 'several health, dental, life, and disability insurance policies from which to choose' with no terms (who pays, waiting period, benefit), so no disability-plan component could be coded; the plan documents are not saved.

Documents cited but not saved: Fla. Admin. Code 6C4-10.104(12) (parental leave rule); USF Sick Leave Pool policy/procedure; USF Health procedures for Extended Leave; Paid Parental Leave for Faculty Request Form / signed agreement; USF Regulation USF10.203 (Benefits and Hours of Work); USF Domestic Partner Health Insurance Stipend Program; FLSA nursing-mother provision (statute text); Florida domestic violence leave statute; USF tenure and promotion guidelines (2015); college governance documents; HR Employee Benefits website.
